tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsang ba'i rnam thar mdor bsdus pa bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ kho bo tā ra nā tha yi/ /gsang ba'i rnam thar mdor bsdus pa// dad dang dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /bskul phyir cung zad bri bar bya//sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam gzigs rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen ldan na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ kho bo gyad kyi gtso bo stobs mtha' med ces bya bar gyur/ lan zhig sangs rgyas de 'khor dgra bcom pa bye ba brgyad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag bco brgyad dang lhan cig spyan drangs te/ zla ba gsum du mchod pa dpag tu med pas mchod/ byang chub tu sems bskyed smon lam btab pas/ 'grub pa'i rtags su/ mi lo brgya'i bar du mchod pa'i me tog kyang ma rnying/ mar me yang rang 'bar ro/ /de nas gzung ste sangs rgyas rnams dang rtag tu 'grogs pa yin/ bar bar de dag tu sangs rgyas la mchod pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa khyad par can bstan pa yang dpag tu med/ rang gi ma dag pa'i skye ba ston pa'i phyir dang*/ ngan song gi sems can smin pa'i phyir/ ngan 'gror skyes pa yang mang*/ sems can phal pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ lha dang mi phal pa'i tshul byas te/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba tsam byas pa yang lan grangs mang ste/ 'ga' zhig mi dran pa dang*/ dran pa yang ches mang ste yi ger 'brir ma lang ngo*/ de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la/ rnga bo che'i mdo bshad pa'i skabs kyi bzang skyong dang phug sbas la sogs pa nas li tsā bi 'jig rten kun gyis mthong na dga' ba'i bar du byang chub sems dpa' lnga brgya yod par bshad pa'i nang gi byang chub sems dpa' blo gros shin tu rnam par dag pa zhes par bdag gyur te/ bstan pa nges pa'i don phyogs thams cad du 'dzin par dam bcas so/ /re zhig ston pa 'di'i bstan pa la bya ba byas pa ni/ 'bar ba'i gtso bo sogs skye rabs bcu gcig klong chen pa dang*/ dwags po bkras rnam pa rje spob dar ba/

brag dkar ba sogs rje grol mchog gis smos zin pas 'dir bshad mi dgos/ gzhan nā len+d+ra'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs mkhan gyi bram ze bde byed bdag por skyes/ theg pa chen po'i gsung rab thams cad yi ger bris/ slob dpon dkon mchog gsum gyi 'bangs zhes pa de yang kho bo dang gcig par smra/ li yul du rgyal po arban+ti de zer ba cig tu gyur/ lo 'ga' zhig gtum zhing sdig spyod kyi tshul du yod pa la/ de nas 'phags pa kun tu bzang po dang mi lab pa bzhin du song nas/ lha khang lnga bcu bzhengs so/ /de nas rgya gar du nag po spyod pa chung ba zhes grags pa zhig tu skye ba blangs/ nag po spyod pa nyid kyi bstan pa dar bar byas/ bod 'dir yang rgyal po za nam ze lde zhes pa dang*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i slob ma dbas mañdzu shrī dang rgyud gcig par smra/ lo tsā ba spong zho gsal ba grags kyang yin te/ rgya gar ma ga nghar slob dpon a gha yā ka ra dang mjal/ thub pa'i dgongs rgyan bsgyur ba sogs gsal bar dran/ sog 'dul 'dzin gyi chos grwa dang nye sa cig tu/ go rub blo ldan zer ba'i sngags pa cig tu gyur nas/ bde mchog dang*/ dgra nag mtshan brjod gsum la brten nas skye bo mang po smin grol la bkod/ 'phral grags chung yang don gyis 'gro don shin tu che/ de skabs kyi yul sogs rnam pa shin tu gsal bar 'dug 'gro mgon zhang tshal pa brtson 'grus grags pa dang*/ grub thob u rgyan par grags pa rin chen dpal dang*/ rgya mgar sgom sogs dang rgyud gcig par khas len no/ /yang phyis byung gi snar thang mkhan po bzod pa dpal grub zer ba dge lugs pa'i dge bshes de dang*/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i bla ma lam 'bras pa blo bzang pa dang*/ slob ma bo dong ras pa dang*/ rgyal sras dngul chu ba'i slob ma hor ka bzhi pa rnams dang rgyud gcig par byed/ jo bo rje'i slob ma yongs rdzogs rnal 'byor pa de yang yin nam snyam pa dang*/

karma pa dgu pa dang yang gcig pas/ dbu se rang dang yang dbyings gcig par 'gyur zhing*/ da lta rgya gar shar nub la dbang bsgyur ba'i rgyal po sa lim pa dang yang gcig ste/ sems can rnams la skal pa med pas nang pa'i chos dar tu ma btub kyang*/ 'gro ba mang po bde ba la bkod pa yin/ dbus gtsang 'di na yang da lta mi chen du mngon pa zhig dang*/ nags shod na mi phal pa cig dang/ mdo khams smad rma chu'i 'gram na bla ma'i tshul 'dzin pa zhig gis mngon pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba la phan cung zad 'dogs/ mi mngon pa'i sgo nas sems can mang po la phan shin tu che ba 'dogs pa zhig yod pa kho bo'i lus kyi bkod pa yin na'ang*/ ming smros na sprul pa bsdu ba'i rten 'brel zhig 'dug pas re zhig smos su mi rung*/ 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dang*/ sangs rgyas gzhan gyi zhing na mang po zhig byung ba dang*/ 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ da lta rang yang shar phyogs mya ngan dang bral ba'i zhing khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa tsam+bha ka'i dpa' po'i drung na/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po ri bo'i rtse mo zhes pa yin pa sogs lus kyi bkod pa brgyad yod la/ da res kyi lus 'di'i sprul gzhi dngos ni/ nub phyogs u rgyan gyi zhing na dpa' bo chen bo biṣ+ṇu rā dza zhes bya ba lha'i lus can 'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor ba cig yod pa de yin/ na ning gi lcags mo phag lo sa ga'i tshes bco lnga la/ byang sham+bha lar dngos su phyin pa'i tshul yang yod/ lus 'di'i rgyun gyi skye ba ni/ skye ba 'di'i 'og tu bod yul 'di khar sde dpon stobs ldan zhig dang*/ dge bshes 'phrin las can zhig ste gnyis yod/ dge bshes des da lta'i chos rgyud 'di mi 'dzin/ sde dpon des da lta'i chos rgyud 'di dar bar byed pa 'dug de gnyis ka la skye ba'i ming mi yong*/ skyai bar grags pa cig kyang 'byang tsam nas 'ong bar 'dug skye ba dngos ni min/

byin gyis brlabs pa ni yin pas/ mtha' 'khob du 'gro don cher ba yong*/ de nas rgya gar du rgyal po chen po zhig tu skyes te chos dar bar byed/ skye ba'i gtso bo dag pa'i lus gnyis te/ gcig ni bde ba can du 'gro 'khor khri phrag tsam yod/ gcig sman bla'i zhing du 'gro ste/ slob ma ni mi mang zang zing yo byad kyis bsod nams kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa gsog par 'dug de nas zhing khams sna tshogs su skye ba'i rim pa gsum bzhi tsam gyis sa lam mtha' dag bgrod nas 'jig rten kyi khams nyi zla skar 'od 'bum gyis bskor ba zhes bya bar sangs rgyas nam mkha'i thig le zhes bya bar gyur te/ 'brel can thams cad thar pa la dngos su 'god pa'i lung bstan yod do/ /tshe 'dir lus 'di la brten pa la/ lus 'di grub tsam na/ dge bshes phal pa ltar brdzus nas 'gro don byed pa'i skal ba can du byung ba'i mkhas pa'i nus pa cung zad yod pa'i tha mal pa'i tshul du byin gyis brlabs pas de ltar gyur zhing sbas pa'i tshul du yod pa 'di yin/ 'on kyang nad drag po byung ba zhig la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dngos su byon nas bkrus pas de ma thag na ba sangs pa dang*/ lhag pa'i lha mang po yang yang mthong ba dang*/ grub thob rgya bod du byon pa phal che ba dang rtag tu 'grogs pa snyam byed pa dang*/ lkog gyur cung zad shes pa rnams gdog dus rtag tu rkyen gang byung yang*/ chos kyi snang ba dang*/ bde ba 'ba' zhig gis khyab/ khyad par phyis byung slob dpon pad+ma dang*/ jo nang kun mkhyen chen po gnyis kyis yang yang bskul nas 'gro don 'phran bu bskyangs pa yin lags/ bdag gi rnam thar zur tsam 'di/ /bu yi don po khyod la gdams/ /snyigs dus skye bos sdig gsog pas/ /re zhig shin tu gsang bar zhu/ kho bo ji srid la 'tsho'i bar du bka' rgyas btab bo/ /bkra shis dge legs 'phel bar shog/ zhus dag/dge'o//

// ༄༅/ /gsang ba'i rnam thar 'bring po bzhugs so/ / oṃ swā sti/ bla ma sangs rgyas la btud nas/ /bdag gi rnam thar gsang ba 'ga'/ /dad ldan 'ga' yis bskul don du/ /g.yo zol brdzun 'khrigs med par bshad/ /de yang kho bo sngon rgya gar du slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyi slob ma rnal 'byor pa zhig tu skyes pa gsal bar dran/ bod du sngags pa bde mchog la yi dam byed pa zhig tu skyes/ yi dam gyi zhal mthong*/ de bzhin du 'bri mtshams su zhang 'brug sgra dang*/ kun mkhyen sang ghā bha drar skyes pa yang ra ri tsam dran/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i mkhas pa chen po klong chen rab 'byams par gyur pa skabs 'ga' re/ re gsal re gsal dran yul na 'dug spyir nged skye ba mang por sngags la nyams len byas/ o ḍi ya ṇa mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams su rig pa 'dzin pa thob pa zhig yin pa/ mi yul du sems can la phan pa'i skye ba len pa yang yang ston dgos byung*/ skye ba 'di'i snga ma dga' byed sa skyong du skyes pa'i skabs thams cad kha sang kha nyin gyi bya byed bzhin shin tu gsal bar dran pa dang*/ lar yang rgya gar du yang yang skye ba blangs pa'i stabs rgya gar shar nub lho byang gi yul phal cher shin tu gsal ba rang yid yul na yod cing*/ tshe 'dir rgya gar gyi skad ma bslabs par phul du byung ba rang byis pa'i dus nas rang shes su yod/ chung ngu'i dus slob gnyer byed skabs rmi lam du/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku dang chos kyi rmi lam sha stag 'ong*/ de yang de dag sgyu ma lta bu'o snyam pa rgyun mi 'chad pa 'ong ba dang*/ lo bcu gcig gi skabs nyin mo yang de ka'i rgyun gyis lug lo'i dmag sogs dus mi bde yong ba'i bde dog thams cad rmi lam lta bur yul le yul le ba la ched 'dzin cher med pa de ka nar mar byung*/ lo bcu drug 'gro skabs shig pa mnam bsam sdings su sbyor drug yun ring du bsgoms pas/

sgom khang du dang por rtags bcu gang rung shar/ de rjes de ka thig le'i rnam pa grangs med rang du song*/ thig le'i dbus na lha sku re yod pa zla gcig tsam byung*/ rting ma zhig la lha phal zhig rdo rje phag mor 'dug pa sngags dir dir sgrog pa dang*/ chos ci rigs pa gsung pa'i rnam pa zhag gcig nyin mtshan khor yug tu byung*/ de rjes lus thams cad zhu bdes khyab/ sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad can rtags shin tu phra zhing brtan pa'i logs rnams thig le thig phran gyis khyab par gyur/ de skabs gegs sel bogs 'don gyis lam du btang*/ re zhig 'phros de nas sgom long tsam ma byung*/ lo bcu bdun pa la yang bsgoms pas/ sngar gyi de ka 'dra ba shin tu brtan pa rang gis lus kyi nang thams cad khyab pa 'dra ba de ka byung ba nas/ thun mtshams su yang snang ba thams cad rtags snang du 'char ba dmigs pa btang res kyis byung*/ lo bcu drug pa la nai gu'i rmi lam sbyangs pa'i skabs shig lho phyogs ri po ṭa lar dngos su phyin pa ltar shin tu gsal bar mthong*/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kha sar+pa ṇi'i sku'i rnam pa dang mjal/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi dang mjal nas dngos su chos gsung pa lta bu byung*/ yang lo bco brgyad pa la bsam sdings su yod skabs rmi lam gzung nas byang sham+bha la bltar phyin pas/ pho brang ka lā pa nyin lam gru bzhi pa zhig 'dug grong khyer nyin lam brgya gru bzhi pa/ de'i phyogs mtshams rnams na nyin lam re tsam re tsam gyis 'khor ba'i grong khyer bcu gnyis kyis khor yug tu bskor ba/ de dag gi bar bar na/ skyed tshal dang nags tshal dang*/ ri dang*/ ljongs phran sna tshogs yod pa/ grong thor bu zam ma chad pa 'dugadabus kyi pho brang chen po bltar phyin pas/ rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku mi'i rnam pa ni ma mthong*/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal rtsa phyag zhe brgyad pa de 'khor lha klu mang pos bskor nas 'od lam me 'dugarigs ldan ka nga yin gsung pa zhig byung*/

de rjes dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' khengs pa zhig gsal bar mthong*/ slob dpon ār+ya de ba dang*/ slob dpon ma taṅgis dbang bskur ba zhal gyi bzhes/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags dpag tu med pa byung*/ lo bcu dgu 'gro ba'i 'jug la rje brag stod pa la gu ru zhi ba'i dbang bzhi zhus pas zhag bdun du nyams 'ur langs/ mthong nyams dang sems nyams zad mi shes pa cig byung*/ de ka'i 'phros skyong ba byung na gter bton chen po zhig yong ba yod na'ang*/ 'phro skyong ba'i rten 'brel ma 'grig/ lo nyi shu'i 'jug la bsam sdings su gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi bsnyen pa bskyal bas/ nang cig tho rangs gnyid la 'gro tshad pa la rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje shin tu gsal ba la 'khor rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can la sgra dang 'od chen po yang snang*/ ja sbyor gcig gi yun tshod tsam du de la sems khrig ge g.yo med du gnas pa zhig byung de nas yal te song*/ yin ni nyams snang yin pa 'dug na'ang byin rlabs ni shin tu che ste/ de 'phral sngar shes pa'i chos thams cad la sngar gyi dang ye mi 'dra ba'i go ba bzang la mtha' chod pa zhig rnyed 'dug de nas gzung shin tu go ba dka' ba'i gzhung kun yang bltas pa tsam gyi rtsol med du go ba 'char ba byung*/ snga sor lo bcu drug pa'i skabs rmi lam tshul du sgrol ma dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'od dpag med gsum gyis lung bstan mtshungs par/ da lo nas khyod rnal 'byor pa a wa dhū tī'i spyod pa can gyis/ chos brgyad rlung la bskur la mdo khams sam/ lho mon phyogs la lo mang sgrub pa gyis/ dang por rang don 'grub nas/ phyis dbus gtsang sogs su sgrub brgyud kyis gzhan la phan che bar 'ong*/ yang na mi ring bar lung bstan zhig 'ong de dus bar chad kyi dbang du mi gtong bar smyon pa'i spyod pa gyis/

slob dpon pad+ma'i byin rlabs dang bsdebs nas 'gro don bzang po yong*/ rang nyams rtogs zla ba yar ngo ltar 'gro/ yang na spyod pa 'dul ba bzhin gyis/ nyams len pha rol tu phyin pa la brten/ snying rje nyams su bstar/ lha spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs pa zhig lo nyi shu tshun la mnga' ris zangs dkar dang*/ gar sha'i mtshams spyan ras gzigs rang byon gyi gnas re phag tu sleb pa gyis shig der bshad sgrub spel mar byas na mtha' 'khob de tshor 'gro phan che/ zhes lung bstan yod pa/ de skabs phyi ma de la mos phyogs che ba yod na'ang*/ rim pas de tsho gang yang lag tu ma longs/ 'di skabs yang sngar gyi lha gsum pau phebs nas da ni khyod kyis tshe 'dir khra'u khre'u la/ 'ur che rab rgya che rab yong*/ thar par khrid pa tho ra tho ra gsung*/ lo nyer gnyis pa'i 'jug la pa mnam bsam sdings na slob dpon rin po che de sku bsnyung ba'i skabs shig nam phyed tsam zhig la mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang mjal/ brda'i dbang bzhi bskur ba dang*/ chos mang du gsungs pa dang*/ lo nyer gsum pa'i ston kar jo nang du bsdad dus nyin mo gnyid phyogs pa'i rmi lam tu sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' dbyings khengs pa tsam byung*/ de'i nub mo dngos su slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang mjal/ he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ mtshan zangs kyi gsung gleng byas/ jo mo nags rgyal yang nged kyi bka' bzhin sgrub pa de nas byung*/ de bar tu sbyor drug bsgoms pas dbu mar stong gzugs ches gsal ba zhag re tsam brtan pa yang byung*/ de byung dus bsam sdings na bsdad na pa mnam gzhung phal cher dang*/ jo nang du yod dus lha rtse nas bo dong bar khang zhing thams cad cig car mthong*/ mi rnams gang byed mthong ba lan mang du byung*/ mi gzhan la bde sdug 'byung ba gsal por shes pa dang sems la ci 'gyu shes la khang khang pa yang yang yong ba cig yod/

de nas lo nyer bzhi pa la brag stod du bla ma dam pa la ngo sprod skyar ma zhus pas gnas lugs rjen cher rtogs/ sems la rang dbang thob pas/ rtsa rlung thig le'i rnal 'byor la rang dbang 'byor/ srid zhi mnyam nyid gyi rtogs pa shar/ sngar kyi stong gzugs kyi nyams rtogs dang rang sems ro gcig tu 'dres/ de la snang ba thams cad 'dres/ de nyid gdod mar shar ba 'di byung*/ rang lo nyer lnga pa la ha bo gangs bzangs kyi 'gram mkha' ro la thog der/ shākya thub pa yum can gyi sku'i snang ba cher gsal ba/ chos zab mo gsung pa dang bcas pa dang rang lo nyer drug gi 'jug la/ 'phan yul glang thang du tho rangs shig paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan lha'i rgyal po'i rnam pa sku mdog dkar po lhag ma byams mgon 'dra ba/ 'khor mkha' 'gro ma mang pos bskor ba dga' ldan nas byon khri la bzhugs pa dang mjal chos zhus pa'i snang ba dang*/ rang lo nyer brgyad pa la dol du mi tra dzo gi'i gsang yum yin gsung pa'i mkha' 'gro ma gcig gis dngos su a ru ra'i 'bras bu rlon pa gsar sol le ba snyim pa kha sbyor du 'dus tsam zhig gnang ba bcud phal cher bzhibs nas 'thungs pas nad ro rnams 'thon lus yang zhing bde ba zla gcig tsam byung*/ a ru ra de da lta chos lung byang rtse na yod/ lo nyer dgu pa'i dpyid ka jo nang na yod dus tho rangs shig sprin seb nas/ rje btsun byams pa ri rab tsam byon mthar nged rang la thim snyam pa na/ nged rang gis lha klu 'dre srin mang po la chos 'chad kyin 'dug

ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams de yal nas kyang*/ gzhan stong gi grub mtha' dbu ma chen po la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ lo nyer dgu pa dang sum cu'i mtshams la dgon par kham mchu'i zir bun gyi sgang la/ jo nang kun mkhyen chen po'i sku'i rnam pa ches gsal ba cig byung*/ de skabs tshes bzhi gcig gi nub mo sku 'bum gyi rdo rje gdan na yod dus/ yang kun mkhyen chen po phebs mtshan zangs kyi chos gsungs/ snga phyi'i lung bstan 'ga' re mdzad/ de nas gzung dngos dang rmi lam du mjal ba shin tu mang*/ da lta nga kun mkhyen chen po dol po pa'i lta ba la mkhas shing dgongs pa skyong ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de lags/ lo so gcig pa la byang stag lung du phyin skabs/ ser le'i ri khrod du 'phags ma sgrol ma sngo ljang gi zhal mngon sum du mthong*/ skye bo rnams 'jigs pa las skyobs shig gsung*/ gtsang gi dmag byung ba'i skabs yul mang po la phan thogs pa'i rten 'brel du go nyams 'ur nas rdo la mkhar ba'i rjes byung*/ de nas da lta'i bar du nyin mo dang rmi lam du lha sku'i snang ba rgyun mi 'chad/ gnyid kyang phal cher dge sbyor gyis 'khyongs/ gang shar thams cad sgyu ma lta bu la rang rig spros bral 'gyur med la 'pho 'gyur med pas blo bde bar gda'/ rkyen grub kyis phog pa dang*/ 'byung ba lus kyi nus pa nyams pas yin pa 'dra/ nyams chu khol ba 'dra ba de zhi ba ltar song*/ lo so gsum pa'i 'jug la brag stod du bla ma rin po che bde bar gshegs pa de grub chen brgyad kyis bskor ba dang mjal chos kyi dogs pa mang pa zhig rang grol du song*/ lo so lnga pa la jo nang sku 'bum gyi mdzod rnams bton pa'i skabs/ nged kyis nyin re bzhin nyin mo'i rnal 'byor dang srog 'dzin bsres nas bsgoms pas/ bde ba'i rten kun+da lta bu'i cha shas cha shas stong gzugs su gyur pa snyam byed/ dbu ma'i nang du gtum mo 'bar ba'i mes lus phyi nang thams cad yog pa/

me'i cha shas la brtags pas thams cad lha skur khrong nge ba dang*/ nam mkha' la ltas dus sku 'bum la mchod pa 'bul ba'i lha grangs med pa rang khrig ge ba byung*/ spyir kho bo la nges 'byung skyo shas 'khor ba mtha' med pa la bsams pa'i bzod par dka' ba dang*/ snying rje shugs drag bcos ma ma yin pa yod kyang thams cad rang rig spros bral du song bas myong bzhin du stong pa brjod mi shes pa g.yo 'gul mi thongs pa zhig yod/ da ste skye ba gsum na mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar nges/ rgya gar gyi grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ bod kyi lo ts+tsha ba dang*/ grub thob phal cher yang mjal zhing rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ yi dam bde mchog 'khor lo dang*/ rdo rje phag mo dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs mdzad dang*/ 'phags ma sgrol ma rnams rmi lam du nam dgos mthong*/ dngos su yang lan re lan re yi dam gyi lha mang po mthong*/ chos skyong gi rigs ni 'phral 'phral mthong na yang smos mi dgos pa 'dug stong gzugs las grub pa nyams snang gi yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems bsrung ma la sogs pa mthong ba la tshad bzung du med par rtag tu 'ong bar snang*/ re zhig de tsam mo//da ni sngar gyi 'phros las cung zad brjod de/ rang lo sum cu so bdun pa la snron gyi zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la/ sgrub gnas skyid phug bde ldan na yod pa'i dus/ nyin mo zhig gnyid du song ba na/ rmi lam zin nas byang phyogs sham+bha la'i yul du 'gro ba'i 'dun pa btang bas/ lam rnams la bgrod pa'i snang ba dang bcas nas/ grong khyer ka lā par phyin/ yul de'i ri dang nags dang*/ grong khyer dang lha khang la sogs pa'i bkod pa thams cad lag mthil gyi spu nyag bzhin du gsal bar mthong ba dang*/ khye'u dkar po gyad kyi gzugs can zhig gis lam sna byas pa'i snang ba dang*/ pho brang chen po ka lā par phyin te/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i sku rigs ldan dang yang mjal/

gsung gi snang ba yang yang thob/ dbang bskur ba gnang bar bzhed pa tsam la/ ja skyel mkhan gyis sgo drung du ting brdung pas gnyid sad do/ /yang lo sum cu so dgu pa la/ dpal gyi chos 'khor lha sar phyin/ dar po che mang du bslang zhing smon lam btab pas/ shākya mu ne'i thugs ka nas gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i yig 'bru 'od 'bar ba mang po zhig byung ste/ rang gi lus la thim pa'i snang ba lan gsum byung*/ bstan bcos ji ltar rigs pa rtsom zhig pa'i gnang ba thob pa yin par sems/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku 'dra gsung byon ma 'dzum zhing bzhad pa'i snang ba dang*/ da lta rtsod ldan dus kyi tha ma yin pas/ phal cher phub ma'i phung po dang 'dra/ 'on kyang nga la mchod pa gyis la smon lam thob/ nges pa'i don la bag chags 'jog pa cung zad cung zad 'ong gsung*/ de nas lo bzhi bcu zhe gcig pa la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs par brtsams pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs phyag gnyis pa/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan par byon nas/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rang nyid skyid chos la ma ltos par chos gzhi 'dzugs pa'ang legs mod kyi/ nga rgyal dang khengs par ma byed cig byang chub tu sems bskyed phyin chad srog chags sbur ma gcig gi phyir du yang*/ bskal pa dpag tu med par sdug bsngal bzod dgos so/ /'dus byas kyi dge ba 'bum las kyang*/ 'dus ma byas gcig dga' 'o gsung*/ sa chog gi gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshe nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa yang rmugs pa 'thibs pa bzhin mtha' khor nas gtor ma len zhing*/ theg chen dang ma 'gal zhig zer ba'i rnam pa byung*/ de nas lo zhe gsum lon pa'i skabs/ zla tshes ni brjed nas thal/ sos kyi dus shig rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i rnam pa gsal ba zhig kyang byung*/ lo zhe bzhi ba'i gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes bcu'i nub mo/ gling pa dar zhes bya ba na/

rgyal po in tra bhu ti 'khor dpag tu med pa la gsang sngags kyi chos gsung pa'i rnam cha shin tu gsal ba dang*/ lan cig lho nub rnga yab gling pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang na/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas 'khor mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i drung du mjal bas/ 'khor tshogs de'i nang na sngar las mthun zhing smon lam gcig tu btab pa yin zer ba'i ngo shes pa 'ga' re yang 'dug go /de ltar na rmi lam dang nyams snang 'khrul pa'i snang ba zar zir la yid brtan rang med mod kyi/ da lta'i dngos kyi snang ba dang*/ rmi lam gyi snang ba gnyis kyang nges par na bden mi bden la khyad med pas/ dngos kyi snang ba la rtsis po cher byas phyin/ nyams dang rmi lam la yang brnyas bcos mi 'tshal la/ rmi lam la snying po med phyin/ sad dus kyi snang ba rags pa 'di la'ang a ma 'thas pa zhig gal che bar gda'/ nga blun po chos med po/ smyon pa brtad med gyi nyams la de ltar shar/ khyed dge bshes gtan tshigs can dang*/ chos mthun gyi sgom chen thugs bsam smrar po ba rnams kyi dgongs pa la ji ltar bzhugs lags// //zhus dag dge legs 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /gsang ba'i rnam thar cung zad rgyas pa bzhugs so// oṃ swā sti/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gi rnam par thar pa'i cha/ /'khrul dang ma 'khrul gang ci'ang rung*/ /ji bzhin bri bar bya ba nyid/ kho bo la nyams dang rtags snang mang po 'ong du re ba med pas/ shin tu gsang dgos rang mi 'dug na'ang*/ rang gi yon tan gyi cha rnams brjod don mi 'dug pas/ re zhig 'di gsang ba'i rnam thar yin no/ /'brug lo'i skabs shigarmi lam du brag rtse zhig na rje grub chen rin po che brag stod pa rnal 'byor pa rus rgyan can zhig snang*/ bdag kyang de'i drung na gos lu haṃ gi gos shig gyon nas 'dug pa'i nam mkhar ḍa ma ru mang po 'dug pa grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi re res nam mkhar bzhag pa yin zer/

de nas nam mkha'i ḍa ma ru rnams hriḥṣ+tī zhes pa'i sgra nam mkha' gang ba tsam 'dug de'i phyi nyin bla ma dam pa'i phyag dam gshin rje gshed kyi sku dang bcas pa gnang byung*/ yang bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dbang zhus dus/ bud med stong phrag brgyad tsam gyis bsu ba byas/ lha khang zhig tu phyin de thams cad kyi ka pā la chang gis gang ba re re byin byung ba gcig tu song 'dug pa nang na yi ge'i rnam pas gang ba gcig tu song 'dug de 'thungs pas snang ba gzhan kun nub/ sems dga' gsal le ba yun ring du byung*/ de dus myong ba med pa ma gtogs gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin par 'dugagating skyes su bla ma dam par bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang zhus pa'i sta gon gyi dus 'od gsal gyi snang ba la/ mu men dang byu ru dang chu shel dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i lha khang mang po zhig tu brtol/ de kun na khri'u brtsigs pa de dag gi steng na gsung rab kyi rten shas che ba 'dug thams cad kyi rting ma lha khang chen po zhig na/ rnam pa rab byung gtsug tor mdzod spu mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i bla ma byin rlabs kyi zil che zhing bag grau ba cig ser khri la bzhugs 'dug de la phyag phul bas shes rab snying po'i mdo yongs su rdzogs pa gsungs pa snyam byed do// dngos gzhi nub mo lha khang sgo bzhi pa gcig gi steng thog la khyogs kyi sne bzhir thag pa btags pa mang por mi mang po bcug sna 'dren gyin 'dug nged rang gis kyang zur rtse zhig nas mang po 'dren gyin 'dug mched grogs dpal mchog rgya mtsho dang*/ gzhung pa rtogs ldan sogs de dus kyi grwa pa rnams drangs pas thag pa chad nas bog gzhan kun yang yan lag chag zer/ drung kun dga' chos ldan lhung yang skyon med par thon byung*/ thog steng der dzo gi rnal 'byor pa he ru ka'i cha lugs su bzhugs pa zhig gis gtso mdzad nas/ skya btsun rnal 'byor pho mo stong phrag lnga tsam 'dus nas tshogs 'khor mdzad/

nged rang g.yas gral gyi gtso bo la 'dug de nas rta lo'i 'jug dang lug lo'i mgo sogs la/ /chos lung byang rtse na rmi ltas shin tu 'tshub cing*/ sel sogs rgyu mtshan 'ga' zhig gis/ de dus der bsdad na mi 'tsho ba'i mtshan ma byung nas gtsang smad phyogs su phyin/ phyis kyang sdod sa'i mthil gtsang smad du byed pa'i rgyu de yin zhing*/ bar skabs chos lung gi dar rgud kyi ltas kyang de dus gsal bar byung nas chos lung rtse sgrub kyi mi sna so so/ smon 'gro ba sten zhal sogs kyang yod/ gnyer pa su 'god kyi gros la/ dpon sa'i drung snyan grags 'god gsung*/ mched grogs dpal sdings pa dbus pa bdud 'dul bskyar nas 'god zer 'dug pa/ da dbus pa bskos kyang gros nyes a long sgor mo yong*/ chags sgo chen po zhig slong na snyan grags bskos/¿lar nged kyi rdog rtsa gros kyi bcol gnyer med/ lan gcig dris phyin nyan na yong ste/ khyed tsho la khar che cig mi 'dug byas/ de nas thog mar snyan grags bskos kyang*/ de nas smon 'gro nas dpon drung gis dbus pa bdud 'dul bskos pa sogs/ deng rang gis lab tshul kun la gsal bar yod// chos lung dgon pa bshas cig longs spyod smar grags thugs dam ma smar grags pa'i skyon gyis de dusanas gzung*/ bar skabs rgya 'dre'i cho 'phrul che bar 'dug bar skabs der nged rang shin tu 'phongs pa zhig yod na'ang*/ /lo de skor slob gnyer shin tu 'phel/ /mngon pa mdzod dang bslab gtus gzung skabs ston pa'i sku'i char babs nas rang la thim pa'i snang ba dang*/ spyod 'jug gi skabs rgyal sras zhi ba lha yin zer ba/ tha sku ra'i rnam pa gzhon nu shin tu mdzes pa/ btsun mo gnyis dang bcas pa ral gri shubs bral re re bsnams pa zhig gis mgron du bos pa'i nyams dang*/ ston ka bsam sdings su sgrol ma'i bsnyen pa byas pas/ g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing yin zer ba/

ri brag nags tshal 'bab chu thams cad margad kyi mdog na yod pa zhig tu sleb pa'i snang ba dang*/ bkra shis rdzong khar dbu ma 'jug pa la bslabs skabs rmi lam du slob dpon zla grags yin zer pa paṇ+ḍi ta chos gos gsum me las grub pa gsol ba zhig dang mjal/ rgyud bla ma bzung dus byang chub kyi skabs su sleb dus rmi lam na nged rang sangs rgyas pa yin snyam pa dang*/ ming yang dri med pad+ma dra ba'i 'od zer/ nga ni zhing rnams su sprul pas 'gro don byed snyam rang 'dra ba'i sprul pa mang po sprul gyin 'dug pa lag mthil la bltas nas 'khor lo'i rtsibs bgrangs pas brgyad brgya las ma byung*/ da dung en tsam zhig bla ma la bsnyen bkur ba'i tshogs ma rdzogs 'dug byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa'i sangs rgyas kyi skus 'gro don byed snyam pa la gnyid sad byams chos gzhan bzhi la ltas 'dra byung ba rnams mi dran par 'dug tshad ma rnam 'grel dang sdom rig sogs kyi skabs ni las 'grel med pa'am/ yod kyang da res ma sad pa yin rung ltas cang ma byung*/ nyang stod stag tshal mkhar khar kyai rdor gyi rtsa rgyud 'dzin 'phrau la mkhan rin po che'i bkas/ sbyor drug gi mun mtshams shig byas pa de dus rang la brtson 'grus med pa'i stabs 'grus pho ma byas 'dug na'ang*/ stong gzugs rang 'dres pa'i nyams la kyai rdo rje'i rgyud yin zer ba po ti khri dpang dang bcas pa la/ man lung gi rgyab kyi ri rtse dang mnyam pa 'dug pa/ nged rang yang khri de la 'dzegs tsa na/ rol mo'i sgra 'brug tsam dang bcas po ti khri dang bcas pa nam mkha' la phyogs sgor mor 'ur 'ur 'degs kyin 'dug pa/ lto skyel mkhan gyis sgo phye ba'i rkyen gyis nyams sad/ dad rdzas sogs nyung ba'i phan yon yin nam/ de dus nyams dang rmi lam shin tu mang yang gzhan la ye ma bshad/ da lta de tsho ma gtogs brjed 'dug chos lung sogs su dam sel 'dra'i rkyen gyis sna khrag shin tu mang ba brdal skabs kyang*/

nyin mo'i nyams dang mtshan mo'i rmi lam zad med cig nub re la yang 'byung ba zla ba gsum tsam byung*/ phal cher du dzo gi ral pa can zhig dang*/ bla ma da lta'i rtsa ba'i bla ma ka yin pa la/ rnam pa rgya gar ba dz+wa la nā tha yin zer ba zhig ste/ dpon slob gnyis kyi rmi lam de rtag tu 'ong*/ des ming yang tā ra nā thar btags pa dang*/ bud med mang pos ḍa ma ru dkrol ba dang*/ nged rang yang gar byed cing*/ a re re re ho/ ā di shud+dhi sarba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ā ro hūṃ a ho/ ki ma shud+dhi ta dze te le hī/ zhes glu len gyin 'dug de skabs sman rim gro rten 'brel sogs ma byas pa sna ga cig kyang med de cang ma phan/ phyag drug pa trak+shad sogs la bskang bshags gang mang byas pas/ rmi lam du bde mchog gi rgyud bzung na phan zer ba byung nas bzung bas le'u bzhi par sleb dus sna khrag 'dzag pa'i thun de chad/ bsam sdings su bde mchog gi bsnyen pa'i skabs rmi ltas mang na yang brjed ngas kyi dbang du song 'dug lan gcig nged kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ skye ba gzhan gyi bla ma yin zer ba/ rgya gar gyi paṇa grub mang po 'tshogs te kun dril nyis brgya tsam gyi gzong ste'u tho'u sogs bsnams nas/ nged rang gi lus la gshog brdungs mang po mdzad nas/ bde mchog gi sku bzo yin 'dug pa/ ji zhag nas nged rang gi lus lhan skyes yum can sngo dmar 'od chags pa mda' gang tsam pa byung*/ sems la 'di yin 'di min cang mi 'dug had de las song*/ chos 'khor lha sar snga res jo bo'i drung du gsol ba btab pas/ thugs kar thug chom gyi sgra dang bcas 'od zer gyi gong bu yungs 'bru tsam snying gar thim pa'i snang ba byung*/ de nas gzung sems la spun langs pa cher ma byung*/ de na a tsa ra mang po yang 'dug

de'i nang na pādz+dza brti zer ba mu stegs kyi tshul 'dzin pa zhig jo bo la phyag mchod mdzad kyin 'dug des kyang byin gyis brlabs pa'i ltas shig byung zer/ yar 'brog tu bu ston yin zer ba byin rlabs kyi zil can zhig gis paṇa zhwa ser po zhig bskon nas/ da 'di kho na gyon gsung*/ don gyi cod pan bcings pa'ang yin pas/ da lta zhwa ser sne ring gon pa'i rgyu yang de'o/ /yer pa'i sgrub khang cha phug tu nam mkha' la rnal 'byor ma zhal gnyis ma lam lam pa lan lnga tsam mthong ba'i nyams byung*/ stag lung du thog ma'i skabs/ rje phag gru'i sku 'dra rin po che byon legs de bla ma dngos kyi rnam par lan gsum mthong*/ phyis rting yang yang mjal ba la rag sku pho ra can zhig las ma byung ste 'dris ches pa'i skyon du snang*/ thang pa chen po'i gdung rten bkra shis dpal 'bar gyi nang na shā rī'i bu'i sku gsung 'byon la khad khad mig btsum pa'i tshe rtag tu mthong ba byung*/ phyi des snang ba gzhan mang po 'gyur gyin 'gro ba cig byung*/ yar lam yol ri gong du zhag gsum bsdad/ bla ma mgon po la gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ nyin lam gsum tsam gyi rgya'i sa dang bar snang thams cad grub pa rig 'dzin kho nas gang ba la re re'i rgyab na nag po chen po re re 'dug pa phal cher dge bsnyen nag po'i rnam pa shas che ba/ de thams cad dges pa'i rnam pa can gyi 'das ma 'ongs ci rigs lung bstan gyin 'dug /de nas bsam sdings su dgun slob gnyer 'phro skyong ba dang sngags bzlas 'dra byed kyin yod dus rmi lam na slob dpon chen po a bha yā ka ra yin zer ba'i pan+ṭi ta zhig la/ dkyil 'khor sna tshogs pa'i dbang zhus pa'i snang ba kho na byung*/ de nas chos lung du rje rin po che rdo ring par lam 'bras zhus dus/ lam dbang gi skabs rmi lam du/ saṃ shud+dhi kīrti zer ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhig gis rgyal chen bzhi dang*/

sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro dkyus ma 'di min pa gzhan zhig gi sgrub skor sogs gnang ba'i rmi lam byung*/ gnyid sad nas kyang ma brjed par 'dug rmi lam du maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su lha sku dngos su mthong ba lta bu'i nyams byung*/ de nas bsam sdings su dbyar thog zhig mdo rtsa bzung*/ 'dul ba la slob gnyer byas dus/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bha ra dh+wa dza gser can gyi snang ba cung mang ba la/ gzhan yang gnas brtan bcu drug phal cher gyi snang ba rmi lam dang nyams kyi tshul du yang yang mthong ba dang*/ de'i phyi lo mun khang zla ba gsum tsam bsten/ de bar sbyor drug gi sor bsam gnyis drag tu bsgoms pas/ ma nges pa'i rtags snang gi 'byams klas shing*/ nges pa'i rtags bcu'ang phal cher byung*/ rting la snying gar e waṃ kha dog drug ldan che chung ril lu tsam shin tu brtan pa zhig yang yang byung*/ snang ba gang byung gi steng du dge sbyor slob dus rtags snang khrig mer ba byung*/ yang de dus 'phags pa don yod zhags pa la/ gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ skye bo mang po dang bcas gru po cher zhugs/ po ṭa la'i gling du sleb pa na/ ri po ṭa la'i rtse mor phyin pa'i tshe/ khang bzang dbus mthongs che ba me tog ldum ra dang*/ khrus kyi rdzing bu yod pa zhig na/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi yin zer ba/ rgya gar gyi dge bsnyen gzhon nu dbu skra ring ba cig g.yon na ut+pal gyi sdong bu dang*/ g.yas na mkhar ba rtse mo pad 'dab can/ /shak+ti kha leb rgyab tu po ti bsnams pa zhig 'dugader sgyu ma lta bu'i ltad mo blta'am gsung*/ 'tshal zhus pas pad 'dab de gdugs su gyur/ der sgo zhig byung bar zhugs pas/ yul phyogs shin tu rgya che ba/ ri dwags mang ba/ lha khang kho nas gang ba ri rtse la dge slong pha ma dang*/ sa gzhi la khyim pa'i rnam pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ lha khang na yang thub pa dang nyan thos mang bar 'dug de'i dbus lha khang chung ngu zhig gi sgor zhugs pas/

yang rgyal khams snga ma las che ba thang 'jam pa zhig na lha khang shing sdong gis mtha' bskor ba kho nas go mtshams med par gang ba snang*/ sgo phal cher yang gnod sbyin yin zer ba ra gdong can dang*/ lug gdong can res bsrung ba zhig 'dug sku 'dra yang thub pa la nye ba'i sras brgyad kyis bskor ba mang bar snang*/ mi rnams kyang lha'i lus dang 'dra bar snang*/ de'i dbus na lha khang zhig 'dug pa'i steng na/ rnal 'byor pa gnyis 'dug pa'i gcig ni nā ro pa yin zer/ gzhan gcig 'dug pa lwa ba pa yin snyam byed/ nang du zhugs dus yul khams ches che ba gcig gis dbus na ri nags 'thug pa mtha' rnams na khang bzang du ma/ phal cher na he ru ka yab yum gyi rigs dang khro bo sogs mang bar snang*/ mi phal cher bud med du 'dug dbus kyi nags khungs shig na bram ze'i cha byad can zhig gi mdun na/ phag sha khog pa cig dang*/ chang bum 'ga' zhig bsgrigs 'dug pa/ 'di nas kyang zo gsung cung zad gsol zhing bdag la gnang ba'ang gsol/ der bris thang sor bzhi pa zhig zhal phye nas thang sku chen por song ste/ thub pa yab yum gyi sku zhig de'i thugs ka na phag mo la bde mchog gis 'khyud pa'i sku yungs 'bru tsam zhig 'dug pa thig le sngon por song*/ re zhig gzhan gyi snang ba nub 'dug yang de'i nang na sngar gyi de kun dang*/ de min pa'i zhing khams kyang mang du mthong*/ yang sku de la phyag spyi bor bzhag /re zhig byar med du thal 'dug da nas phyi rol gyi de thams cad dus gcig tu mthong*/ thams cad kyi sems shes pa snyam byed 'dug der zhal snga nas/ da ci snga ma de sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin yin/ bar du byar med had de ba de dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin yin/ phyi ma 'di ni rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin yin zhes/ sogs ngo sprod mang du mdzad/ der tho rangs kyi bya khur byung ba'i rkyen gyis sad/ yang phyi nub slob dpon 'dug pa las/

bum pa zhig gis dbang bskur snga ma las lhag pa'i dkyil 'khor mang por zhugs thig le bcu drug gi dbang dang man ngag la nges pa gting nas rnyed do/ /chos lung du yod skabs/ smon 'gro ba'i zhal ngo bkra bzang pa'i sku skyes yin zer ba de yang 'grongs pa'i ltas kyang gsal bar byung ba zla bo kun la smras te/ de yang pad+ma brag khung na bud med mang po 'tshogs pa'i gral mgo la nged 'dug pas/ gcig gis tshogs sha long zer/ bud med gcig gis khong ri dwags su byas khyer byung ba/ gzhan gnyis kyis bshas te tshogs 'khor byas pa rmis/ yang snar thang nas byang chen du yong dus shig rmi lam du ri sul zhig gi phug cig tu zhugs pas/ rin po che 'od dwangs pa 'ga' las byas pa'i khang pa zhig tu song*/ de na rnal 'byor pa gzhon nu zil che ba dza lan dha ra'i rgyal po yin zer ba gcig gis/ mi shas gang pa'i ka pā la zhig lag tu gtad byung ba zos pas ro ni dper mi mtshon pa zhig snang*/ da ni rig pa 'dzin par song snyam pa dang nam mkha' la thog med du 'gro ba rmis/ sang nyin rje btsun rgya gar lho phyogs pa bud+dha gup+ta nā tha phebs byung*/ sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dbang zhus pa'i nub mo/ deng rang gi lus ri gcig tu song*/ de'i sa rdo rnams bud med mang po'i blangs nas/ mkhar ri tsam cig brtsig gin 'duganang spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang du 'dug 'di nga rang gi lus po yin snyam pa 'dug der lam zab mo mang po zhig gnang ba dang*/ lo gcig gnyis bzhugs pa'i zhal bzhes yod pa la/ da res rgyu mtshan 'dras mi yong 'dug phyis cig bya gsung*/ nang par rkyen zhig gis de nas thugs 'gyur/ da res gzhung rnams la bshad pa tshar re bya/ man ngag gi rkang grangs tsam byed/ dmigs pa rnams blo la bzung zhig nga rgya gar la mgyogs po rang 'gro gsung*/ der dzā lan+dha ra'i dwa ha phal cher dang*/ bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa'i de nyid bdun pa dang*/

rang byin rlabs sems kyi phyag rgya dang*/ dgyes rdor gyi gzhung 'dra gsung las bris/ dmigs pa rnams dpe rigs dang*/ brjed thor byas bshad pa rnams brjed tho'i mchan bu 'dra byas/ de nyid bdun pa mdzad par bskul pa'i nub mo/ byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad yin zer ba yig mkhan skyes pa shin tu mdzes pa brgyad 'dug pa/ nged rang gi pags pa la shog bu byas/ khrag gis snag tsha byas/ rtsib ma la smyu gu byas/ mdo rgyud thams cad 'dus pa'i glegs bam yin zer ba zhig bris pa'i yon du/ rus gong skra sen so sogs phul/ nang khrol rnams la ston mo byas pa'i snang ba byung*/ de nas nan gyis gsol ba btab kyang ma thebs par zla ba gcig nas rgya gar la bzhud/ de'i nyin yid mi dga' bzhin yod pa/ tho rangs rmi lam du gu ru phebs nas/ da nga khyod kyi mgo la sgrub khang byas nas lo 'bum sdod gsung*/ da ste mi lo 'bum nas nga yang sangs rgya ba yin pa 'dugagu ru slar phebs pa re dga' snyam dga' yal yal ba la gnyid sad/ yang bsam sdings su dbyar dus shig ri shin tu mtho ba'i rtse sul na/ slob dpon ār+ya de ba dang*/ ma taṃ gi yin zer ba paṇ+ḍi ta dang rnal 'byor pa zhig 'duganam mkha' gang mthong ba'i rgya khyon 'ja' 'od las grub pa'i rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor shin tu gsal ba snang*/ der phyag rgya sngags sogs spros bcas kyi cho ga cig mdzad kyin 'dug pa la/ dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas bu mo glu len pa zhig gis lcags kyi bum pa lcang lo can gyi mdzod kyi chu mig gi chus bkang pa yin zer ba bla ma la phul/ der bla ma des bdag la khyod rnam rtog shas che/ khyod nga rgyal che/ khyod rnal 'byor pa la dmod/ ces lan gsum bka' bskyon par mdzad nas/ phyis 'di blos slang du song ba'i tshe chu 'dis legs par se ka bya gsung*/ rgyud don mang po yang gsung gin 'dugatho rangs gnyid sad dus phal cher ma brjed 'dug

de ka'i snga dro nas gdan bzhi'i mngon rtogs chen mo bzung bas/ nyi phyed yan la tshig cha thams cad zin/ phyag rgya kun yang sgrig thub tsam byung*/ de'i nang par rgyud rkyang zhig bltas pas kyang go ba bzang po byung*/ de'i mngon rtogs la sngar mig 'dris dang rna chags yang ni ye med do/ /yang lan gcig khang pa zil che ba gcig tu phyin pas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa khri chen po rgyab yol rgyan sna drug can zhig la bzhugs 'dug yar khri la 'dzegs chos rje bla ma'i gdan la bsgrigs nas 'dug phyag mgo bor bzhag byung bas byin rlabs kyi zil che bar byung*/ mchod rten phyi rdul gyis gos pa zhig snang*/ bud med cig 'dug pa la dris pas 'di jo nang kun mkhyen pas bzhengs pa phyis 'di rdul gyi gos nas yun ring lon/ rdul je che la song*/ da dung khog 'di na zil zhig mi 'dug gam/ khyod kyi 'di gdab dar gang thub gyis zer/ de nas gting skyes su phyin pas/ dam tshig gtsang ba'i stabs yin nam/ nyams rmi lam sogs gsal snang mang ba cig byung*/ de nas jo nang du lan cig rmi lam na nags rgyal gyi mgul na bud med mang po gur cig gi nang na 'dug pas gtso mo des khyod la rigs sngags shig 'bul zer zhig bshad byung ba phyis kyang ma brjed par gda'/ de nags sman der snang*/ de nas bsam sdings na yod pa'i dus shig bka' babs brgyud 'debs bkod pa'i paṇa grub so drug po de steng khang na bzhugs/ bar khang na shān+ti gup+ta bzhugs/ 'og khang na gu ru lho phyogs pa dang rje grub chen gnyis bzhugs 'dug der tshogs 'khor mdzad/ steng khang pa kun gyi zhags skyugs gnang ba kun shān ti gup+tas gsol/ des zhal skyugs gnang ba bla ma gnyis kyi gsol/ de gnyis kyi zhal nas 'o ma 'dra ba dang*/ chang 'dra ba dang gzhan yang sna tshogs byon/ bdag gis 'thungs pa rmis/ mtshan tser gyi 'od gsal yug cig la song*/

de nas zla ba tsam la nyin mtshan gnyis char gu yangs chal chal ba/ phyi nang 'char sgo thams cad dga' yal ba/ bde lam lam pa/ gtad sa med pa'i pang yud gang sar rjes med du thal/ de dus smon 'gro nas jo nang pa'i kham mchu'i 'phros kyi lab long 'dra la gnyer pa chos skyabs sleb byung*/ dngos su ma 'phrad kyang dam sel can de'i rkyen gyis/ dpe'i ye shes bde stong gi nyams te 'phro chad song*/ yang snga sor yol ri gong du byung ba ltar/ grub thob kyi tshogs shin tu che bas tshogs 'khor mdzad pa zhig byung*/ ci yin dris dus/ bstan pa 'di la ston pa dngos zhal ma mjal yang*/ sngags kyi lam las sa thob pa rnams yin zer lar 'di lta bu lan bzhi byung ngo*/ /yang lan gcig nged rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma phal mo che gung la bzhugs/ g.yas na phag mo gru pa dang sa paṇa/ g.yon na rje bu ston dang tsong kha pa chen po/ bar de dag ni rnal 'byor pho mo kho nas gang 'dug phyi'i mtha' thams cad dge slong snam sbyar gsol ba kho nas mtha' bskor 'dug bla ma de kun gyi zhal nas sde pa bzhin du grub mtha' la phyogs ris ma byed/ khyod rang la grub mtha' 'gyur med rkang tshugs pa/ a la la 'di 'dug pa/ chos de bzang dgos pa yin/ 'chang pa dang go ba tsam pos mi phan gsung*/ spyir de kun dang khyad par rje grub chen gnyis zhal 'dzum 'duga.e waṃ chos pa bzang po bzang po 'dug ha ha zhes lan gsum gdangs dang bcas gsung pa 'brug sgra tsam byung*/ don gnas lugs la gtad pa med pa'i rig rig cig byung*/ de nas bde mchog bla mchod brtsams dus rje grub chen dang*/ bir+wa pa'i sku'i snang ba byung*/ nga shi na'ang legs snyam pa byung*/ lan gcig nyams 'dra ba gcig la rang gi pang du gang nas byung cha med pa'i bu mo lo bcu gnyis lon pa tsam zhig 'dug su yin snyam pa la wā ra hī ho yin zer/ lo snga ma la stag lung du nga'i sgrub thabs 'bri bar chad ma byas sam/

da myur du bris zer yal song*/ de nas ston 'dul byung du rmi lam na/ rje stag lung thang pa de nyid chibs pa nag po zhig mdzad/ nged kyi stag lung gi las thams cad zin/ da tsa ri la 'gro gsung*/ bla ma mi 'byon par zhu byas po ti gcig phul bas chibs bshol tsam byung*/ da khyod kyis stag lung pa'i bstan pa 'di skyongs gsung*/ jo nang na yod dus dwa ha la 'grel pa zhig brtsams dus/ man ngag bdud rtsi'i bcud 'di ni/ de ring ston no bzang mo kye/ /zhes par slebs skabs kyi nub mo gu ru lho phyogs pa nags sman rgyal mo yin zer ba gcig phyag rgyar byas nas dbang bskur ba zhig rmi/ byang chen du ri bo sman ljongs lhun chags pa zhig na/ rje grub chen 'khor rnal 'byor ma shas che ba dang bcas pa bzhugs 'dug der ka pā la mang po gcig tu song*/ nang bdud rtsi mda' gang tsam 'phags pas gang ba/ bdag la gnang ba phal cher 'thungs/ lhag cung zad dang bcas sku mngon du bzhag pa rmis te/ zhal lung zab mo go ba'i ltas su go 'jag tu rmi lam sprul bsgyur sogs che zhing*/ dge slaung gi sde chen po lung pa gang ba tsam zhig la/ sgyu ma rmi lam gyi chos bshad cing*/ de ring gi 'di kun yang yi ger bris na/ bka' rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum tsam yod pa 'dug snyam pa byung*/ mdun na a tsa ra mang po dag gis gar byed/ khyung po'i yin thang dang mgon po'i rdo sku la yang sku dngos lta bur snang ba dang*/ sems dpa' gsum rtsegs kyi rnam pa sogs mthong snang khyad par can byung*/ de nas de lo rje rin po che brag stod pa'i zhal mthong ba tsam la/ snang ba thams cad ban bun chod chod rmi lam ltar song*/ sngar nas mos gus thun mong ma yin pa yod mod/ da res byin rlabs kyi thugs rjes sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i mos gus la snyems 'khrigs rdul tsam med pa'i ltem 'grus skad cig kyang mi 'tshor ba byung*/ de nas rtogs par rlom pa kun yang 'ching byed kyi shun par song*/

brjod bral 'di la ci zhig brten par bya zer ba de phyogs mthun tsam byung ngo*/ /chos kyi rang bzhin shes gyur na/ /ci tshug byas kyang rnam thar bzang*/ /gang ltar byung kyang legs pa yin/ /bla ma'i rnam thar ngo mtshar che/ /zhes pa rang lo nyer bzhi pa yan chad kyi gsang ba'i rnam thar sgro skur gyi dri ma med pa 'di ni/ bsam gtan gling pa rgya mtsho pad dkar gyis bskul te/ tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi smras pa ste brag stod chos kyi pho brang du'o//

// dge legs 'phel lo/ /zhus dgasarba maṅgalaṃ/ dge'o/ bkra shis// // ༄༅/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rnam thar bstod pa dad pa'i ljon shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i ljon shing zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog 'jam dbyangs grub pa'i mgon/ /kun dga'i dam chos snying po'i don ston pa/ /gang de'i ngo mtshar mdzad pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /mchog tu dang ba'i yid kyi phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpag yas tshogs gnyis yun ring goms pa'i mthus//bod yul dbus kyi sa yi thig le mchog /chos bzang lha yi mdun sa dang mtshungs par/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul ston la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul rdo rje'i mtshan/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i rigs su nyer bltams pa/ /kun bzang grub pa'i dbang pos lung bstan bzhi/ /rnam 'dren mchog tu 'khrungs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /'du ba rnam bzhi 'khrugs pa'i nyer 'tsho yis//rnam par gtses pa'i tshe na grub pa'i mgon/ /'bar ba'i mgon po dngos su byon nas kyang*/ /phyi nang bar chad bsal la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /de tshe rlung sems dhū tīr tshud pa yis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas dpag yas mkha' la gzigs/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bag chags yongs sad nas/ /dad pa stobs su gyur la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /gzhan gyis ma bstan yongs su ma bskul bar/ /'gro ba kun la snying rje'i 'jug pa rgyas/ /theg mchog lha dang rigs sngags dam chos tshul/ /ngang gis yongs su mkhyen la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /yi ge'i phyi mo la sogs rang mkhyen zhing*/ /skye rabs gleng gzhi la sogs gtam mang rnams//'bad rtsol med par thos pa tsam gyis chub/ /'khor mang dga' ba skyed la mgos phyag 'tshal/ dgyes pa'i rdo rje rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /mi g.yo sgrol ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs kyi/ /sgrub thabs du ma lo bdun lon tshe gsungs//blo gsal kun gyi gtso bor mgos phyag 'tshal/

mkhas mchog byams pa'i gsung ngag nyer bsten te/ /sde snod gsum dang de yi dgongs 'grel dang*/ /sgra tshad rig pa'i gnas lnga kun la sbyangs/ /mtshungs med smra ba'i seng ger mgos phyag 'tshal/ /kun dga'i mtshan can bla ma chos rje yi/ /zhabs pad nyer bsten sdom gsum rim pas nos/ /dpag yas rgyud sde'i dbang lung man ngag gis//thugs rgyud yongs su gang la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin zhing*/ /gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i rdzogs rim nyams len gnad/ /rtse gcig bsgrub la nyin mtshan lhur mdzad pas/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam ston mgos phyag 'tshal/ /mdo rgyud dgongs pa ji bzhin legs mkhyen nas/ /'chad dang rtsod dang rtsom pa'i tshul lugs la/ /srid gsum 'di na 'gran pa'i zla bral ba/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyod la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dbang 'byor zhing*/ /'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod kun gyi/ /mkhas grub bye ba'i bzhed srol ji bzhin du/ /ma 'dres thugs su chud la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin mngon brnyes pas/ /rmi lam mtshan ma'i tshul du bar chad bgegs/ /rnam par btul nas stong nyid zab mo'i don/ /mngon du gyur pa gang der mgos phyag 'tshal/ /'phags yul mkhas grub zhal lung bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /sangs rgyas spas pa'i zhabs sogs bla ma las/ /legs par gsan nas thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /zab don rgya mtsho'i bdag por mgos phyag 'tshal/ /dpag med skye rabs 'phreng bar mngon 'brel ba'i/ /gdod ma'i mgon po rdo rje slob dpon mchog /brgyud pa kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*//thugs yid dbyer med 'dres la mgos phyag 'tshal/ gang las mthar thug de nyid nod pa'i tshe/ /gnas lugs gdod ma rang bzhin lhan cig skyes//chos kun ngo bo chos sku mngon gyur te/ /srid zhi'i mgon por gyur la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /zab cing rgya cher dpag yas dam chos don/

/mtha' dag gcig gyur don gyi brgyud pa brnyes/ /rdzogs rim zab mo'i ye shes mngon gyur pa/ /bde chen dang po'i rgyal bar mgos phyag 'tshal/ /'phags yul shing rta chen po bcu drug dang*/ /grub thob 'khor los bsgyur ba bgrang yas kyi/ /bka' babs byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags mtshan thob/ /chos kyi rgyal po bla mar mgos phyag 'tshal/ rdo rje theg pa'i 'phags lam rjes mthun sa/ /bcu gnyis rdo rje'i gnas pa mngon gyur te/ /rtsod pa'i dus 'dir rdo rje 'chang dbang gi /gdung 'tshob gyur pa gang der mgos phyag 'tshal/ /skye ba kun tu rjes bzung yi dam lha/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i bsnyen sgrub la brtson tshe/ /bdag nyid he ru kar gyur mtshan ma gzigs/ /ya mtshan dpag yas mnga' la mgos phyag 'tshal//sgrol ma'i dbang bzhi nod tshe rang gis lus/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi yongs sbyangs byin brlabs te/ /mtha' dag rgyud kyi glegs bam rnam par gyur//gsang sngags bstan pa'i bdag por mgos phyag 'tshal/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor mngon gzigs shing/ /'phags pa lha yis the tshom dra ba bsal/ /zhi ba lhas kyang 'dus pa'i rgyud don bstan/ /chos rgyun ting 'dzin brnyes la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor mnyam bzhag pas//thog mar dge ba'i rtags rnams mthar phyin zhing*/ /srog 'dzin rtags snang du ma mngon gyur pa/ /bcos min ye shes gzigs la mgos phyag 'tshal//dpal ldan gsang 'dus don la mnyam bzhag pas/ /'jam dbyangs thugs rjes chos kun de nyid gzigs/ khro rgyal gshin rje gshed pos byin brlabs pas/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug gyur la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i don la mnyam bzhag tshe/ /rang lus lha sku'i gsal snang cher brtan zhing*/ /gnas gsum pho nya'i 'du ba legs thob pa/ /lhan skyes bde chen thob la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /rnam dag thugs mnga' khyod kyi mnal lam du//mda' bsnun shā ba ri dang lū yi pa/

/dril bu 'bar 'dzin zhi ba sbas pa sogs/ /grub mchog du ma'i zhal bstan mgos phyag 'tshal/ /de dag rnams la the tshom gcod mdzad cing*/ /rgyud sde'i dgongs don rnam par 'grel pa'i tshe//dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag yas brda thabs kyis/ /zab don ngo sprod brnyes la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /dga' ldan gnas nas shākya'i mtshan ldan pas/ /zhal bstan mi pham mgon paus bdag nyid la/ /dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma thob/ /chos 'byor rgyun mi 'chad la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas zla 'od gzhon nu dang*/ /rton pa bzhi ldan la sogs mchog rnams dang*//dam pa chos kyi bka' mchid yongs thob pa/ /bshes gnyen mchog gis rjes bzung mgos phyag 'tshal/ /thos bsam mthar phyin rtse gcig sgrub la dgyes/ sa steng chos kyi 'khor los khyab mdzad pa/ /ya mtshan mtshungs med bla ma rin chen la/ /mchog tu gus pa'i yid kyi mgos phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa 'di yan chad slob ma'i ngor tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //zhus dag/maṅgalaṃ// // ༄༅/ /rdo rje'i gnas pa bcu gnyis shin tu gsang ba nyams rtogs kyi rnam thar lags so/ / na mo gu ru we/ oṃ sangs rgyas dpa' bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e yig nam mkha'i khams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gi sems nyid rang rig pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha bdag /dus lan gcig rigs ni sad/ rkyen khar ma lus par sems nyid kyi gnas lugs gcer mthong zhig yong 'dod pa'i skabs/ lo 'ga' shas shig la 'char sgo byung ba rnams sdom du byas pa ni 'di ltar/ byin rlabs kyi mtshan kha nam zla sa chu dros pa 'dra ba'i pha bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir smras pa/ bhar+ṣa snga ma'i snga ma la/ lha sku mahā su kha nam/ blo ldan gnyis med sbyor ba la/ snying po yod pa ltar snang yang*/ he tu rkyen dang phrad pa tsam/ 'on kyang de ba ḍā ki nī/ dpa' bo'i ye shes kyis bskul yin/ /gtsug tor la ni yid gnyis can/

de 'og bgrang bya'i tshogs pa la/ the tshom rtog pa dbyings su yal/ /byin rlabs ye shes rgyus khyab pa/ /de las rtsol ba med na yang*/ mi rtog gsal bar snang ba thob/ /de nas lo de song ba na/ /rje bo'i zhal rgyus lcags kyu yis/ /rnyog pa'i mtsho las rab drangs nas/ rab mchog gnas kyi khri la bzhag /rdo rje'i gnas pa dang po'o// //༈ gnas lugs mngon sum du gzigs pa'i pha rgod de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir smras pa/ snron gyi dang por bdud kyi sde/ /tshig gi rdo rjes rab bcom nas/ /ye shes klong du kha badz+ra/ /'gyur med 'gyur ba sna tshogs tshul/ /ngo bo mthong dang ma mthong bral/ /'khrid dang 'khrid bya 'khrid po spangs//bi shwa tsi tra dbyings su yal/ /chu klong bye ba rgya mtshor babs/ /gol sa thams cad mthong nas chod/ /'bangs rnams kun gyis rgyal por bkur/ /drang ba nges pa'i don du zhugs/ /rdo rje'i gnas thob gnyis pa'o// //༈ thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba'i bla ma dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dab brgya'i dbus su sgron me gsal ltar 'bar/ /ri dbang rtse mor kai la sha rgyas pa/ /'tshub ma zhi bas nam mkha' dri ma med/ /zla ltar rab tu shar ba bi bud dha/ /lha yi lam las char phab nas/ /sa mu dra la dbyer med 'dres/ /char 'bab ces pa'i ming yang med/ /snying rje ro gcig gsum pa'o// //༈ ha la'i nags tshal 'chi med sman du sgyur pa'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir smras pa/ grong khyer chen po la ni lam srang brgya/ /grangs med sgo ni chen po drug phye ste/ /mi shigs pho nya 'gro 'ong byed par ston/ /yul gzhan pho nya grong khyer der zhugs pa/ /mi shigs rgyal po'i mdun na ci bder rgyu/ /phyogs bzhi'i yul nas gtso bo'i bang mdzod bzhi/ /bdud rtsi'i dga' ston 'thung ba ngo mtshar rmad/ /gdams pas bcings gyur 'di ni bzhi pa yin// //༈ rang bzhin bde ba chen po mkha' ltar khyab pa nyi ma bye ba'i gzi brjid dang ldan pa bla ma dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/

/'dir smras pa/ ki rān+ta 'gram chu klung ngogs su skyes pa ni/ bā mā ram pa'i lus can kun tu spen pa zhig /dbang bsgyur zhing skyong dbang mos lha lam las drangs te/ khyim bdag skor ba gcig la rdo rje'i gnas su bzhag /slob dpon rdzu 'phrul ldan pa mthong 'di'ang skal ba bzang*/ /gtor blugs yon tan mchog dang dus ni mngon du gyur/ /bla ma'i drin gyis thob 'di'ang shin tu ngo mtshar rmad/ /gsum rang yin/ gsum rab mchog gyur slob dpon de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dbyings su thim//de 'og 'bras bu rnam par smin/ /zla ba'i tha mar mtshan nyid bral/ /brtan par gyur pa bi ma ra/ /rtsibs bzhi'i 'khor lo rnam par 'khor/ /kāṃ yig gis ni sa gsum khengs/ /rdo rje'i gnas pa lnga pa 'dis/ /nyon mongs ye shes rang dbang bsgyur// //༈ rang sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su ston par mdzad pa bla ma dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir smras pa/ rang gi yid las skyes pa chu zla bzhin du gos med gzugs/ /zab yangs 'od zer bye ba 'bum gyis mngon par 'khyud pa'i lus/ /kri t+ya mu dra sa ro ru har spyod pa'i bung ba ni/ /ban+dhu'i sbrang rtsi 'thungs pas daṇ+ḍi'i bu ga rnam par phye/ /de 'og bdud rtsi'i chu yur 'bum/ /gyen du bgrod pa sa gzhir thim/ /dbyer med su kha ak+ṣa ra/ /ba spu'i sgo la rnam par gnas/ /mu ṣa'i dmar phyogs tshes bcu la'o/ /zla ba de yi mtha' 'phel la//rgyu lus zung 'jug ri mo bkra/ /sna tshogs du ma dbyings su shar/ /rdo rje'i gnas pa thob pa 'di/ /drug par sgrags te ngo mtshar rmad/ /bi d+ya sna tshogs thabs chen las/ /rkyen la ma ltos bde chen mtshan// //༈ rdo rje'i slob dpon dam pa chos kyi dbyings kyi rang snang du shar ba/ dbang 'khrid skam po dang tshig bshad skam pos dge bshes su nga rgyal byed pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa ni/ dper na nyi ma shar bas skar ma thams cad bag la zha ba bzhin no/

/de lta bu'i bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir smras pa/ nam mkha' kun tu song ba de la mtha' yas dngos po rjes su 'jug /mkha' la nam yang 'gro 'ong yod min dngos po skye 'jig ma 'gag pa/ /gcig nyid kun tu 'char ba 'di ko khyab rtags chu nang zla gzugs bzhin/ /rnam pa du ma rang bzhin mi 'gyur spros pas dben pa don gyi mchog /srid lam rgyu ba nam yang bcad/ /ye shes nyi ma nam yang shar/ /'di ko gnyug mar gnas pa la/ /nam yang mthong ba med 'di mtshar/ /gang zhig bde ba'i ye shes srid gsum sgron//gzhan las skyes kyang gzhan byung ye shes min/ /bdag tu spros pa zhi yang dam pa'i bdag /lus las byung kyang lus las ma skyes pa/ /gzugs brnyan rmi lam brag cha lta bu yi/ /bde bas bde ba mtshon 'di mtshon du med/ /gang la'ang ma chags dngos po bdun la chags/ /de 'dra 'di las ya mtshan ci yang 'char//gnyis chos ma yin zung 'jug dkyil 'khor rgyas/ khyab brdal rdo rje'i gnas pa bdun pa'o// //༈ brda dang dam tshig la sogs pa thabs sna tshogs kyi nges gsang can/ bla ma dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir smras pa/ ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i rol rtsed gang 'dis srid gsum ye shes 'khor los sgyur bar byas/ /gnas brtan rgan po skye rgu'i bdag po mgo bregs brtul zhugs tshangs spyod chen po pa/ /gang gzhan dka' thub pa dang 'dod ldan dag kyang 'gyur bcas phyir na 'bras med mtshungs/ /char dang nyi ma sman gyi dbang por rtse mo can mtshungs de nyid nges par rtogs/ /sems las lus kyi a k+ṣa ra/ /kā ya su khas sems brtan byed/ /rdul gyis dwangs pa'i me long bzhin/ /gdod nas rnam dag deng 'dir shar/ /oṃ yig las ni sgyu 'phrul che/ /sgra dbyangs kun ldan yi ge āḥ /'gyur med hūṃ gi rdo rje can/ /gnas thob pa 'di brgyad pa'o// //༈ rgya dang kha ris bzhin du slob ma la ye shes 'pho bar mdzad pa po bla ma dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/

/'dir smras pa/ chu stod kyi ni dang po la//nam mkha'i rdo rje sham ba ra/ /bsti gnas 'phur 'gro lta bu ru/ /bdag nyid pa ra bā mār bcas/ /mchod pas mkha' dbyings khyab par sprul/ /ka ra ka rā lu gur rgyud/ /mchod 'os he ru ka zhabs btud/ /cang te'u 'khrol zhing 'di skad du//a tsin ta yi gnas su sna tshogs mar gyur gzhan du ma ṇi bha ri de rjes ut+ta rar/ /su ra su rī gzhan yang nā gi zhes dang 'dir ni rab dga'i sa gzhi shin tu gnyen gshin yid/ /sa hā dza dang nan dā nan da mtha' yas rab spel mchog gi go 'phang bdag la sbyar bar bya/ /sha ku bākra reg las dzñā nāṃ pa ra mchog thob rdo rje'i gnas pa 'di ni dgu pa'o/ /zla ba nyi ma me dang shel/ /rnam par gsal zhing rab tu dwangs/ /sems kyi rang bzhin de 'dra ste/ /rkyen gyis bsgyur bas sna tshogs nyid/ /mar me yis ni nor bu 'tshol/ /zhun mar don du me sgrub cing*//srub shing la gnas me mi mthong*/ /shing srin gyis ni shing 'bigs byed//'du byed thams cad sprin dang mtshungs/ /nang rig bde ba nam mkha' nyid//ji ltar srad bu mkhal ba las/ /ye shes 'di ko ngo mtshar rmad/ /'dab brgya sprang rtsi'i zil mngar ro/ /ku mud gnyen dang 'grogs de ci/ /rab 'bar nā ḍī'i nyag phran gyis/ /rnam rtog gcod cing 'khor lo 'bigs/ /nyon mongs brgyad khri'i tshang tshing du/ /dpa' bo 'jigs med nyams dgar rgyu/ /'phrog byed dang ni chu bdag rmongs pa'i gnas/ /thos sgrogs rigs rnams shin tu 'khrugs gyur zhing*/ /sems dpa' 'ga' la'ang skrag pa skyed byed pa/ /rdo rje'i theg pa 'di ni bsam mi khyab/ /'di ni dgu pa de'i 'phros don no/ /༈ chos sku nyag gcig gi rang bzhin pha rgan bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo//'dir smras pa/ rang byung hastī khams drug mche bas spras pa gang 'dis rā ga'i 'dam rdzab rnyog ma brgyas gang ba'i/ /dbus su bde ldan ap+pa dza de dri mas ma gos rab dkar rtsa ba yang yang 'bad pas zos/

/ri sul brag cha'i sgra las sgra skad thams cad mi 'jigs seng ge'i sgrar gyur 'di yang ya mtshan gnas//spu long 'khril shing gyon du g.yo ldan zla ba'i rgya mtsho brtan par 'khyil zhing 'khor ba 'di yang mtshar/ /nam mkha' las ni nam mkha' byung*/ /nam mkha' nam mkha'i dbyings su thim/ /nam mkha' phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor te/ /'byung ba thams cad nam mkha'i dang*/ /ye shes ka na ka shro tam/ /gzung 'dzin rnyog bral dwangs pa la/ /bde chen rlabs 'phreng ci yang g.yo/ /rdo rje'i gnas thob bcu pa'o// //༈ bla ma dam pa rang gi sems nyid dang gnyis su ma mchis pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir smras pa/ lo hi ta yi 'phel ba rdzogs tshe rigs kyi bdag po'i zhal bum las rnyed dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /rang bzhin gcig min du ma ma yin thams cad gcig gyur ye shes gcig pu srid 'das kun tu shar//las dang sgom dang bcings dang grol ba gzhi lam 'bras sogs mnyam nyid ngang nas 'khor gsum dbyings su gtor/ /byar med las bral bdag med don dam rang gis rang la rdo rje'i gnas thob 'di ni drag po'o/ /bdag por gyur la slob dpon gyis/ /bdag po'i gnas su dbang bskur nas/ /snying pos snying po kun snying por/ /bgyis te kun tu rgyas par gdams// //༈ 'khor 'das brtan g.yo kun gyi rang bzhin rtsa ba'i bla ma gcig chog rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir smras pa/ thig le'i zla ba'i tshes kyi dus/ /dzñā na badz+ra pra be sha /'phar g.yo bde ba brtan pa dang*/ /maṇ+ḍa la las dz+waṃ la thim//sa ma ya ni gsum pa'i dus/ /nam mkha' in+d+ra dha nu bkra/ /sgra dbyangs brag stong ra ha s+yaṃ/ /tsit+ta badz+ra su kha na/ /bzhi pa mnyam nyid rang bzhin te/ /nam mkhar nam mkha'i du hi tā/ /la ba nī bcas rig spyod bu/ /bdud rtsi'i chu klung brgya phrag 'thung*/ /sā dhu sā dhu zhes pa'i sgra/ /lha yi lam las sid dhi ka /brgyad gnyis grangs kyis mngon par sgrags/

/de nas tsakra ar tsa naṃ/ /phyogs kun dpa' bo mtha' dag rig bcas rnam 'gyur du mas sgeg 'chang gang zhig a nus sad kā rnam par spel las bi rā ga/mkhar nyal rnams kyi rnga sgra snyan pos srid gsum mchod pa ya mtshan kun bsdus dam pa'i bde chen nam yang rab bskul bdag kyang der/ /ye shes kun nas rab dga'i sa gzhir thabs mkhas zlos gar ci yang bsgyur las snying po'i ye shes lhag par rgyas pa gang 'di ko/

mtha' dag srid par chos kun tshul gyis 'gro ba sgrol slad rig spyod snang bas khyab par gyis zhes rdo rje'i gnas thob nyi ma'o/ /'di rnams smyon pa tā ra nā tha'i sla col gyi yi ge yang dag pa'i nges tig can de'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa/ shu bhaṃ/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/gsang ba'i rnam thar sogs rnam thar 'ga' zhig bzhugs/ - PAGE 290 -- PAGE 289 - -PAGE 249-
